name: eval-e03
intent: 暗紫色的星云状流动背景，缓慢演化，带少量颗粒感

params: tc Particular-0782
Use a wide Box emitter so the soft particle volume spans the composition.
tc Particular-0014
Make the emission volume broad enough to avoid a localized cloud with visible boundaries.
tc Particular-0146
Build a dense but still diffuse atmospheric field.
tc Particular-0011
Keep particle travel slow for a drifting nebula rather than a particle burst.
tc Particular-0113
Emit uniformly in all directions for amorphous cloud structure.
tc Particular-0002
Keep particles alive long enough for a continuous fog-like volume.
tc Particular-0703
Use Glow Sphere particles to merge into soft cloud masses.
tc Particular-0027
Use oversized soft particles so individual dots fuse into nebula forms.
tc Particular-0074
Vary particle sizes to prevent regular-looking blobs.
tc Particular-0033
Keep each particle dim so the overall result remains a dark background-grade violet.
tc Particular-0075
Introduce restrained opacity variation for organic mottling.
tc Particular-0088
Set Color to At Birth before assigning the violet particle color.
tc Particular-0070
Color the luminous fog a deep violet rather than bright white.
tc Particular-0069
Additively blend the dim glow spheres into soft nebula density.
tc Particular-0018
Enable air resistance before turbulence so turbulent motion affects the cloud.
tc Particular-0711
Gently displace particles with turbulence to morph the cloud structure over time.
tc Particular-0715
Use large turbulence features for broad gaseous curls instead of fine jitter.
tc Particular-0716
Add enough turbulence detail for layered cloud variation.
tc Particular-0035
Enable modest motion blur to keep moving cloud particles smooth.
tc Particular-0036
Use a natural shutter angle that does not smear the soft texture excessively.
expressions: Slowly drift the emitting cloud mass across the frame so t1 and t4 visibly evolve.

params: BCC_TEXTURES-1001
Add only a restrained surface grain so the cloud remains soft and dominant.
BCC_TEXTURES-1002
Increase fine texture detail for subtle close-inspection particle character.
BCC_TEXTURES-1018
Use a tight texture scale so the texture reads as grain rather than paper.
BCC_TEXTURES-1019
Keep the grain scale even in both dimensions.
BCC_TEXTURES-1003
Choose a non-default texture variation to avoid a generic repeating pattern.

_rationale: A dense field of large, low-opacity violet Glow Sphere particles accumulates into soft, edge-free nebula clouds over the near-black purple background. Low velocity, broad turbulence, and a slow emitter drift provide visible four-second structural evolution, while a low-strength fine BCC texture supplies the requested restrained grain.
pass_criteria: soft cloud/nebula structure filling the frame (no hard edges)
dark purple/violet palette, dark overall (background-grade luminance)
evolution between t1 and t4 (structure moved/morphed)
subtle grain visible on close inspection
